protocol.question: Does the fraction-label advantage persist after accounting for the observation likelihood of a majority vote?
protocol.primary_endpoint: accuracy on independent single noisy test responses
protocol.selection: minimum single-response validation log loss; first minimum wins
protocol.normalization: negative log likelihood per physical training query, omitting parameter-independent count constants
protocol.intervals: paired percentile bootstrap over devices; primary 95%, secondary descriptive pointwise 95%
protocol.scope: new simulated devices; local protocol fixed before these devices are generated, not an external preregistration

evaluation_only: true_probability and clean use the simulator weights; never passed to fit
